extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed final mechanism ontology from main-text source sections and figures; missing local supplementary DOCX was not used to fabricate extra values.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: A11 forms an amphipathic alpha-helical structure in negatively charged membrane-mimetic SDS conditions; this supports membrane interaction but is not by itself a killing assay.
mechanism_claims.limitations: CD supports conformation in model conditions; it is not direct bacterial killing evidence.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: TAMRA-labeled A11 associates with or penetrates S. Typhimurium cells over the measured incubation time course.
mechanism_claims.limitations: The result supports cell association/penetration, not a standalone intracellular target assignment.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: A11 causes time-dependent membrane permeabilization and depolarization in S. Typhimurium measured with PI and BOX staining.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Main text gives representative quantified effects; supplementary figures are not locally parsed and are not used for additional exact values.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: TEM shows membrane disruption and intracellular structural changes after A11 exposure, supporting membrane damage with later non-lytic effects.

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=30:Membrane integrity and intracellular alterations; xml:fig=8:Figure 8

mechanism_claims.limitations: TEM morphology supports membrane and intracellular alteration but does not identify a single molecular target.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: A11 binds bacterial genomic DNA in a gel-retardation assay, supporting a possible non-lytic intracellular interaction.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: A11 with S. Typhimurium genomic DNA
mechanism_claims.limitations: The paper treats intracellular targeting as a suggested mechanism requiring further assessment; final curation preserves that limitation.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Time-kill data show rapid reduction and killing of S. Typhimurium by A11 at MIC and 2x MIC concentrations.

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=25:Antibacterial activity of candidate peptide; xml:fig=3:Figure 3

mechanism_claims.limitations: Killing kinetics establish efficacy over time, not a distinct molecular mechanism.
